oasis_1.name: OASIS-1 (Open Access Series of Imaging Studies)

casas.name: CASAS Cognitive Assessment Smart Home Dataset
casas.population: Community older adults performing instrumental activities in smart home
casas.notes: Original score reflects activity completion score; tier reflects processing step

tihm.name: TIHM (Technology Integrated Health Management) for Dementia
tihm.population: People living with dementia monitored via home IoT telemonitoring sensors
tihm.license: Open Government / University of Surrey Restricted Research Deposit
tihm.notes: Contains passive IoT sensor events, no digital UI assistance labels

ai4hope.name: AI4HOPE Palliative Care Conversational AI Dataset
ai4hope.population: 60 dementia clinical/palliative experts and 60 family caregivers
ai4hope.license: Open Access / EU Open Science (Horizon Europe / UKRI)
ai4hope.leakage_rules: Mandatory GroupKFold grouped on user_id across the 60 experts/caregivers

brain_it.name: Brain-IT Exergame Motor-Cognitive RCT Dataset
brain_it.population: Older adults with mild neurocognitive disorder (61% Alzheimer's disease)
brain_it.leakage_rules: Sample size N=41 strictly for adherence modeling, not population normalization

vase.name: VASE (Video Analysis Scale of Engagement) Dataset
vase.relative_path: research_archive/Complete data set, Lai et al..xlsx
vase.population: 11 subjects with advanced dementia observed during music and arts sessions
vase.leakage_rules: Clips are 25s observational slices in live music; cannot be used as software inactivity timer

canterbury_wellbeing.name: Canterbury Wellbeing Scales for People with Dementia
canterbury_wellbeing.population: People living with diagnosed dementia (45.8% Alzheimer's) attending museum/arts sessions

robot_cognitive_training.name: Social Robot Cognitive Training with LLM Prompts
robot_cognitive_training.population: 20 healthy older adults (MMSE 28.65) interacting with social robot

motor_sequence_learning.name: Motor Sequence Learning Across the Lifespan
motor_sequence_learning.population: Healthy individuals across the lifespan (32 healthy older adults ages 60-80)

n_back_dementia.name: N-Back Working Memory and tDCS in Dementia
n_back_dementia.population: 24 dementia participants stratified by baseline speed (12 normal RT, 12 slower RT)

alzheimers_tablet_rct.name: 6-Month Tablet-Based Multimodal Training RCT (Zuschnegg et al., PLOS ONE 2025)
alzheimers_tablet_rct.relative_path: research_archive/DATA - The effect of a 6-month tablet-based multimodal training for cognitive functioning in Alzheimer’s disease in a randomized controlled trial.xlsx
alzheimers_tablet_rct.population: 25 individuals with mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's disease (13 intervention, 12 control)
